subtasks: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the objects.
With the right hand pick up the broom, then sweep the remaining black object into the dustpan with the other objects.
Pick up the loaded dustpan by its handle with the left gripper and hold its lip in front of the black object. Use the broom in the right hand to sweep the black object inside.
Grasp the handle of the loaded dustpan with the left hand and hold its opening beside the black object.
Sweep the black object diagonally forward and left across the dustpan lip with the right-hand broom.
Release the dustpan and broom on the table and immediately return both open hands to their starting positions.
